answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37075 Country: India Title: khwab Question: Mai ne ye khwab 4 mahine ki jamat me dekha tha. Mai aur mere amir sahab dono ne ek jaisa hi khawab aur ek hi raat me dekha tha. khawab ye tha ki bahut sara pani tha har jaga pani hi pani tha aur bahut se janwar pani me beh rahe the aur sailab tha aur pani bahut unchayi se neeche ki taraf aa raha tha. Answer ID: 37075 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 448/448/M=1433) Sins prevail everywhere. When mischiefs and evils prevail, then all people good or bad are caught in it. May Almighty Allah save us from His wrath! Everyone should correct his belief as well action. The dream indicates towards the same. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
